summary: A strong shortlist choice for an atmospheric, flexible riverside evening: illuminated landmarks and multimedia displays turn the Chao Phraya into an outdoor spectacle. TAT's current festival calendar lists 13 November–13 December 2026. The detailed 2026 venue map and show timetable were not available in the official pages reviewed; photographs show earlier editions, not guaranteed 2026 attractions.
whyGo: See Bangkok's riverfront architecture transformed after dark.
Combine a few displays with dinner and a riverside walk rather than committing to a full-day excursion.
bestFor: Couples and groups wanting a relaxed evening
Travellers already staying near the river
skipIf: Your Bangkok dates begin after 13 December
You need guaranteed fireworks or drone performances on a specific night
Crowds, flashing lights or loud effects spoil your evening
duration: Allow 1–3 hours for selected viewing spots, plus dinner and transfers; planning estimate.
cost: 2026 admission terms await a full programme. Public viewing was free in 2025; transport, dinner cruises and private restaurant seating cost extra.
hours: 2026 daily times unconfirmed. Official 2025 reference: 18:00–22:00, not a current show schedule.
bestTime: After dark; select a bank and viewing position once the 2026 map and individual show times appear.
gettingThere: Choose the actual display first, then use rail plus a walk or river connection to the relevant pier. Do not assume every riverboat operates until the final show; check the return journey separately.
booking: Await official public-access details. A paid cruise is optional; before booking, ask which confirmed 2026 displays its route and timing actually include.
accessibility: No festival-wide access specification found. Public walkways, pier steps, boat boarding and crowded viewing areas vary; confirm the exact site or book suitable riverside seating.
practicalTips: Pick two nearby stops rather than trying to cover both banks in one night.
Arrive before your chosen performance and leave time for queues and crossings.
Carry water and a charged phone; keep an alternative land route home.
Treat old fireworks dates and 2025 posters as historical references.
decemberNotes: The official listed window includes 1–13 December 2026 only. Do not transfer the 2025 closing date of 23 December or its fireworks weekends into this year's itinerary.
uncertainties: Exact 2026 locations, performance nights, fireworks/drone schedule and admission arrangements remain unverified.
Weather, river conditions and programme changes may affect outdoor viewing.
